# SIP-01 Search

> Static, serverless search client for the SIP-01 decentralized web index (Nostr kind 39697). No backend, no API key, no login — the page queries public relays directly from the browser and verifies every observation against the canonical protocol logic before showing it.

## Machine-readable search

- `/?q=<query>&format=json&limit=40` — runs the search and returns a JSON document: `{ version, query, complete, pending, relays, generatedAt, documents, observations, dropped, results[] }`. `limit` (1–200, default 40) caps observations per relay. Requires a JavaScript-capable reader (browser automation); re-read while `complete` is false.
- `agent/sip01-search.mjs` — zero-dependency CLI and MCP server (Node 22+): `node agent/sip01-search.mjs "query"` for JSON on stdout, or `--mcp` to serve the `search` tool to MCP clients.

## Agent instructions

- `agent/SKILL.md` — drop-in instructions for AI agents (search via the JSON view or a direct relay REQ, verification rules).
